title: Single-Molecule Force Spectroscopy: Experiments, Analysis, and Simulations.
authors: Mesbah, Ismahene; Sumbul, Fidan; Valotteau, Claire; Rico, Felix
one_liner_zh: 该文综述单分子力谱实验与分子动力学模拟（特别是SMD）结合分析蛋白质机械展开，虽为方法综述但聚焦蛋白质结构力学计算，与课题相关。
abstract: The mechanical properties of cells and subcellular components are important for a mechanistic understanding of biological processes. The quantification of the mechanics of cells and biomolecules using biophysical methods has matured thanks to the development of nanotechnologies such as optical and magnetic tweezers, the biomembrane force probe and atomic force microscopy (AFM). Force spectroscopy allows the determination of the forces required to unfold protein domains and to disrupt individual receptor/ligand bonds. Analytical models allow a phenomenological characterization of the underlying energy landscape. Molecular dynamics simulations allow the study of similar biological processes in atomic detail. In this chapter, we first provide a roadmap of force spectroscopy measurement and analysis and its interpretation in terms of available theories. We then present the background for molecular dynamics simulations, focusing on steered molecular dynamics (SMD) and the importance of bridging computational tools and theoretical frameworks with experimental techniques. We finally provide a step-by-step protocol of AFM-based and SMD experiments.
abstract_zh: 细胞及亚细胞组分的力学性质对于理解生物学过程的机制至关重要。借助纳米技术，如光镊、磁镊、生物膜力探针和原子力显微镜（AFM）的发展，利用生物物理方法量化细胞和生物分子的力学特性已趋于成熟。力谱技术能够测定展开蛋白质结构域及破坏单个受体/配体键所需的力。解析模型允许对潜在能量景观进行现象学表征。分子动力学模拟则能在原子细节层面研究类似的生物学过程。在本章中，我们首先提供力谱测量与分析及其在现有理论框架下解释的路线图。随后，我们介绍分子动力学模拟的背景，重点聚焦于受控分子动力学（SMD）以及将计算工具和理论框架与实验技术相结合的重要性。最后，我们提供基于AFM和SMD实验的分步操作协议。
